text: Yes, but they'll remember the main when we catch them. All hands assemble for divine service. Attention! Almighty God, bow safe in thy wisdom to guide us speedily to victory, so that the sufferings of the unfortunate may cease, and our starry flag may triumph and wave as a sign of thy love and care for humankind. Amen!
